_review_1: Bader 27 Nov: horse voice not nice -> use the Avenues (Nike ep10) horse voice = ElevenLabs Mohamed; line 01 'بشتري' not 'أبي أشتري'. Horse takes B replace 01/04/06/08/10/12 (Horse Deep 2).
_review_2: Bader 28 Nov: 08B ياخذون sounded with long alif; wants ya + hamza (يأخذون). Takes 08C (spelling) and 08D (diacritics).
_review_3: Bader 28 Nov: B/C/D all wrong. Kuwaiti ياخذون = ya + long alif (no hamza), خذون said quickly; عمولة ends in ha (عموله) not ta. Takes 08E/08F.
_review_4: Bader 28 Nov: 'أيوه كذي صح' on 08E/08F -> 08F (the quicker one) picked. Audio gate approved.
